items.title: Braskem Creditors, Shareholders Said to Move Closer to Agreement
items.summary: Braskem’s creditors and shareholders are moving closer to a deal to rework some $11 billion of debt, according to people familiar to the matter.

items.title: Obama, in Ohio, assails 'cruelty' and indecency from Trump and his allies in the midterm campaign
items.summary: Obama targeted GOP gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy, who has doubled down on an ad featuring the estranged mother of Democratic rival Dr. Amy Acton.

items.title: Trump casts his midterm election ballot early in Florida
items.summary: Asked if he voted the Republican party line, Trump, who was wearing an "I Voted" sticker, said, "Very much so."

items.title: Saudi Arabia Suggests Riyadh Airport May Reopen on Sunday
items.summary: Saudi Arabia’s main airport was gearing up to reopen as early as Sunday after operations had been disrupted by a spate of attacks by Houthi rebels.

items.title: American embassies tighten security as Iran threat warnings intensify ahead of U.S. midterm elections
items.summary: A memo from DNI director Jay Clayton said Iran is in the "advanced stages" of planning attacks against Americans.

items.title: After SpaceX restores high-speed service, Musk claims Ukraine violated Starlink agreement
items.summary: Ukraine says restrictions on Starlink and Starshield have been lifted, restoring connectivity to fast-moving military systems after disruptions.

items.title: Braskem Discloses Details of Debt Rework Proposals to Investors
items.summary: Braskem SA said it disclosed to certain debt holders and investors details of restructuring proposals related to an $11 billion out-of-court debt rework.

items.title: Violence flares in Paris after massive, largely peaceful protests across France
items.summary: France's Interior Ministry said 410,000 people took part in protests nationwide, though unions said the true figure was twice as high.
